items.html: And the matter is, that it is known that the Gevurot are called Elokim, and the posteriors of Elokim of the filling of Heys amount in gematria to one thousand [alef], like this: Alef, Alef-Lamed, Alef-Lamed-He, Alef-Lamed-He-Yod, Alef-Lamed-He-Yod-Mem. And these are the sum of the thousand worlds, which is the Elokim of the Heys in the secret of the posteriors of the Gevura of Atik, which clothed and were sealed in the Mocha of AA, called the pure ring, as is known. For the upper one does not clothe in the lower one except in the secret of the posteriors alone, and not the internality, as mentioned.
